name: Chitter
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Your Colony makes a loud chittering sound, unsettling your foes. Each time a foe attempts to move within Short Range of you, roll Spirit vs Fortitude against them. On a win, that creature must spend all its available movement to move away from you.
successes:
✨: The creature takes -1 Defense for the next round.

🌞: The creature checks a Condition.
